about: How a line-synced (optionally word-timed) LRC file becomes lyric lines. Owner decisions 2026-11-22: a line with several timestamps is shown at every one; credit lines (lyricist, composer, ...) are hidden; a line's last word ends where it starts (it lights up at once). Also: "<R>" at the start of a line puts it on the right (align end); [offset:] is in milliseconds and a positive one shows lyrics sooner; gaps follow core/contracts/lyrics-gaps.json. nuvx-core::lyrics::lrc::parse_lrc (desktop) and Android's LrcLib.parseLrc (through nuvx-ffi) must agree. A line is [startMs, text, align, words]; a word is [text, startMs, endMs].

cases.name: a line with two timestamps is shown at both
<R> puts a line on the right
word stamps make words; the last word ends where it starts
lines are put in time order
